#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

class IntStack {
public:
    vector<int> array;
    int size;

    IntStack() : array(8), size(0) {}
    IntStack(int capacity) : array(capacity), size(0) {}

    void push(int item) {
        if (size >= (int)array.size())
            array.resize(array.size() * 2);
        array[size++] = item;
    }

    int getSize() const { return size; }

    int get(int i) const {
        assert(i < size);
        return array[i];
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;

        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

        Modulus() {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }

        long long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.getSize() <= n) {
                factorial.push((int)mult(factorial.get(factorial.getSize() - 1), factorial.getSize()));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.getSize() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            assert(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) const {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0) x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a - b;
            return v < 0 ? v + modulus() : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long mult(initializer_list<long long> args) const {
            long long r = 1;
            for (long long i : args)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long long inv(long long value) {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& in;
    string buff;
    size_t pos;

    InputReader(istream& s) : in(s), pos(0) {}

    string next() {
        while (pos >= buff.size()) {
            pos = 0;
            getline(in, buff);
            if (!in) throw runtime_error("Input error");
        }
        size_t start = pos;
        while (pos < buff.size() && buff[pos] != ' ') pos++;
        string token = buff.substr(start, pos - start);
        if (pos < buff.size()) pos++;
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();

    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    mod.fInv(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        long long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
        if ((k & 1) == 1)
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
